prompts.anchor:
Use the attached image ONLY as costume, face, weapon and rendering reference. Create ONE full-body Sanada Yukimura sprite, strictly SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT, in a BATTLE-READY SPEAR GUARD, on flat pure magenta #FF00FF background.
Keep the red lacquered armor with gold fittings and detailed lacing, golden deer-antler red helmet, white headband and white waist sash, dark brown hakama, red greaves, straw sandals, red scarf, red back sashimono with six gold coins, same mature sharp face and stubble. About seven heads tall, realistic adult proportions. Painted anime realistic, crisp dark outline, cel shading, strong rim light.
POSE: low fighting posture. Both knees visibly bent; hips lowered, spine inclined slightly forward, eyes looking toward the enemy on the RIGHT. His front anatomical RIGHT leg is bent toward the right and supports him; LEFT leg braced behind toward left. BOTH HANDS grip the SAME long cross-shaped spear shaft, widely separated: rear hand near the left hip and forward hand at the right lower chest. The spear is held diagonally FORWARD AND UP toward the right, approximately 25-35 degrees above horizontal, cross spearhead projecting ahead of his face toward the upper-right. The rear butt points down-left. This is a controlled ready stance for guarded advance, no strike yet, no dramatic deep lunge. Do not reproduce the reference's upright vertical-spear stance. Hands must visibly contact the continuous shaft. Entire spear including butt and cross head, antlers, banner, scarf and both feet fully visible and comfortably inside the canvas. No ground, shadow, labels, text, grid, borders or other poses. Landscape canvas with one central character and ample pure magenta margins.
prompts.a:
Animation production sheet for a game: exactly FOUR full-body poses in a single HORIZONTAL row, evenly spaced, isolated from each other. Pure flat #FF00FF background, no ground shadow, grid, borders, numbers or text. Use the attached character as costume/face/painting reference, but rotate the CAMERA to STRICT RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE: see one eye and one cheek, shoulders stacked in profile, far arm partly hidden. NO frontal torso. SAME adult realistic proportions, red armor, antler helmet, scarf, six-coin banner, white sash, brown hakama, red leg armor, sandals and cross spear.
ALL FOUR POSES are GUARDED ADVANCING ON A BATTLEFIELD. Keep hips LOW, knees bent throughout, torso slightly leaning right, intense gaze right. Both hands MUST hold the cross spear in a ready guard: rear hand near hip, forward hand near chest, shaft diagonally pointing up-right about 30 degrees. Spear never vertical, arm never dangling. Spear and scarf contained within each pose's magenta area, nothing cropped, generous outer margins. Weapon stays steady while the bent legs cycle. This is a careful bent-knee advance, not a relaxed stroll, not a run, not an attack thrust.
LEG IDENTITY IS ESSENTIAL: camera-side anatomical RIGHT leg always brighter/crisper and occludes the darker FAR anatomical LEFT leg. When legs overlap, draw the near RIGHT leg on top; do NOT relabel legs with light based on which leg is leading. Camera and all faces face RIGHT consistently.
These are the FIRST FOUR consecutive phases of an eight-frame walking loop, left to right:
POSE1 contact: NEAR RIGHT leg in FRONT extending toward the RIGHT, its foot on ground. FAR LEFT leg trails back toward LEFT, toes touching, both knees bent.
POSE2 down: weight settling on the right foot forward; hips dip slightly; far LEFT heel lifts behind.
POSE3 passing: RIGHT foot still planted under hips; FAR LEFT knee swings FORWARD toward RIGHT and passes the right support leg, left foot lifted slightly above ground and nearly alongside the right ankle. Legs CLOSE together, not wide. Hips stay low; never straighten up.
POSE4 left swing: FAR LEFT knee and foot extend AHEAD toward the RIGHT, foot just above the ground. NEAR RIGHT support leg stays BEHIND toward LEFT. The far left thigh is partially occluded by the near right thigh. Near right shin is clearly on the LEFT side of the two legs at this phase.
Prioritize the anatomical leg change and maintained two-handed combat guard. No repeated poses.

These are the LAST FOUR consecutive phases (5,6,7,8) of an eight-frame loop, left to right. Their near/far leg positions are the OPPOSITE of the first half:
POSE1 (phase5) left contact: FAR LEFT foot lands AHEAD to RIGHT, near RIGHT foot trails BACK to LEFT. The near/right knee and greave clearly sit on the LEFT side; far/left greave sits on the RIGHT side but is darker and behind the right leg at overlap. Ground contact on the far left foot.
POSE2 (phase6) down: weight on far LEFT foot forward on RIGHT; low hips dip slightly; NEAR RIGHT heel and foot begin to lift BEHIND on LEFT.
POSE3 (phase7) right passing: far LEFT foot planted under hips; NEAR RIGHT knee passes FORWARD toward RIGHT, near right foot lifted slightly beside and in front of grounded left ankle. Near bright right leg obscures part of the far left leg. Legs CLOSE together.
POSE4 (phase8) right swing: NEAR RIGHT bent knee and foot reach AHEAD to RIGHT, foot airborne just before landing. FAR LEFT support foot trails BEHIND to LEFT. Next phase is near/right forward contact.
The near right leg is the leg closest to the camera throughout, brighter and overlapping the far left. It must start BEHIND in the first two poses and move FORWARD in the last two. Maintain the crouched ready stance and BOTH HANDS gripping the diagonally-forward spear at ALL times. All feet, spear tip and spear butt comfortably inside canvas, enough outer margins.
The attached first reference shows the desired guarded upper body. The second reference shows the first four phases only for continuity, do NOT repeat their leg arrangement. Match rendering, body size and weapon length.

combat: 戦場の移動: 歩き・疾走の人物は腰を落とし、膝を曲げ、重心を少し前へ置く。武器は戦闘の構えを維持。幸村は両手で槍を斜め前、景勝は刀を両手で前、三成は右手鉄砲の照準を前・左手扇子、信長は銃と刀に合う戦闘の警戒姿勢、信玄は軍配を構え、武蔵は二刀の間合いを守る。手ぶらは右拳前・左拳後の握りを維持。直立・散歩姿勢は不採用。
